name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited
summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited provides integrated supply chain solutions in India. The company operates in two segments, Integrated Supply Chain Solutions (ISCS) and Global Forwarding Solutions (GFS). The ISCS segment engages in sourcing and procurement, integrated transportation, logistics operation centers, in-plant logistics, finished goods, aftermarket fulfillment, and supply chain consulting operations, as well as offers integrated final mile solutions, including closed loop logistics and support, which comprises spares logistics, break-fix, refurbishment and engineering support, and courier and consignment management services.
